terra.problem: The card identifies Straight Street, not Straight Gate. Neither the verses nor the source establishes that they are the same place.
The Lord’s conversation with Ananias happens in Damascus, but the verses do not say it happens on Straight Street.
The title “Saul receives his sight” is not shown in Acts 9:11–17. His sight is restored in Acts 9:18.
Ananias expresses concern about Saul, but the verses do not explicitly say he is afraid.
